title: Sleepaway Camp
blurb: A cult summer-camp slasher with one of horror's most notorious endings, two jokey sequels, and a belated sequel that pretends those never happened.

groups.title: Return to Sleepaway Camp
groups.note: A direct sequel to the first film that ignores II and III.

note: Return to Sleepaway Camp is a direct sequel to the first film and ignores parts II and III. The first film's ending is the reason anyone watches the rest; don't let anything spoil it.
